clue.text: Snack meals taken by advertising man, by the way

definitions.text: taken by advertising man, by the way

parts.note: a sandwich is a typical light snack
board means meals provided, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: A street advertiser stops for a quick bite and his food by the roadside.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes the twin placards an advertising man wears as he walks along the street ('by the way').
explanation.definitionFit: A pair of hinged placards worn front and back by someone parading the street to advertise.

clue.text: Inside story of subscription scheme

parts.note: a plot is a scheme or secret plan

explanation.surface: Someone reveals the hidden truth behind a subscription racket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inside story' looks like an exposé; here it is a secondary narrative running within the main one.
explanation.definitionFit: A secondary thread of narrative running within a novel or play.

clue.text: Dreadful thing disturbs birds

indicators.note: dreadful suggests something mangled, so the word thing is rearranged

parts.note: jars means jolts or disturbs

explanation.surface: Something horrible upsets the birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dreadful' rearranges THING into NIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Nocturnal insect-eating birds with a churring call, also called goatsuckers.

clue.text: Anger in the Cape

definitions.meaning: Cape ... is the north-western tip of mainland Scotland

explanation.walkthrough: Cape Wrath is the headland at the north-west corner of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrath is strong rage, and also gives its name to a Scottish headland.

clue.text: Getting over clanger I stupidly made

indicators.note: stupidly signals that the letters of clanger and I are muddled

explanation.surface: Someone recovers from a foolish blunder they made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' is a link. 'Getting over' means getting past an obstacle, as a horse does a fence.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse clears a fence when it jumps over it without touching it.

clue.text: One that flies higher than an eagle

definitions.text: One that flies higher than an eagle

parts.words: One that flies higher than an eagle
parts.note: reads like a soaring bird, but in golf a score one under par is higher than one two under par

explanation.definitionFit: A golf score of one under par for a hole, which is a higher score than two under.

clue.text: Vegetable oils, for example. 1 block

parts.note: oil paintings are an example of art
the Roman numeral for one is I
to choke is to block or clog

explanation.surface: Cooking instructions warn that oils may clog a single pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A thistle-like plant whose flower head is eaten as a vegetable.

clue.text: A way to climb with exercises in hanging

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the letters read upwards, so A and the road abbreviation are turned

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
PE is physical education, exercises

explanation.surface: A route up a rock face involves exercising while dangling from a rope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to climb' turns A plus RD into DRA; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A drape is a curtain or cloth hung up, a hanging.

clue.text: Author of horror story who feeds the flames

definitions.meaning: a person who tends a furnace or boiler fire

explanation.definitionFit: Bram Stoker wrote Dracula, and a furnace attendant shovels in coal.

clue.text: Pack up fruit in cases

definitions.note: plural noun here for the mass noun luggage

parts.note: to bag is to put into a bag, pack up
a gage is a plum, as in greengage

explanation.surface: Fruit is packed into cases for transport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link. A gage is a variety of plum, as in greengage.
explanation.definitionFit: Luggage in general: suitcases and bags taken on a journey.

clue.text: Withdraw treatise on religious education

indicators.note: on here means the treatise is written after the subject in an across answer

parts.note: RE is the school subject religious education
a tract is a short treatise

explanation.surface: Someone takes back an essay they wrote about religious teaching.
explanation.definitionFit: To take back a statement or pull something back in.

clue.text: Line one missed out in letter to Bar

indicators.note: missed out in says the numeral is dropped from inside the spelt-out letter name

parts.note: aitch is the spelt-out name of the letter H
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A letter to a pub owner is missing a line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; Bar looks like a pub, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A latch is a bar that fastens a door or gate.

clue.text: Gunners under scrutiny promise to provide admission later

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners
in check means held under control or examination

explanation.surface: Soldiers being inspected are promised entry at a later date.
explanation.walkthrough: A rain check is a ticket for a rained-off event giving admission another day.
explanation.definitionFit: A ticket stub for a postponed event, honoured on a later date.

clue.text: Transport route that could go into terminal

indicators.note: the answer's letters could be rearranged to form the word terminal

explanation.surface: A railway line heads into a station terminal.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: the answer, rearranged, goes into TERMINAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Rails laid in the street for trams, so a track that trams run on.

clue.text: Such characters appear to be threatening action

parts.note: to lower or lour is to look dark and menacing
a case is a legal action

explanation.surface: Some people look as if they are threatening to sue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters' looks like people; they are printed letters. Lower rhymes with 'flower' here.
explanation.definitionFit: Small printed letters, as opposed to capitals, are kept in the lower type tray.

clue.text: Control supplies of commodity in a tight spot

definitions.meaning: to ... a market is to control its supply
a difficult position with no way out

explanation.definitionFit: To monopolise a market, and also a difficult position with no escape.

clue.text: Late-comers aren't scolded by hostess here

definitions.text: Late-comers aren't scolded by hostess here

parts.words: Late-comers aren't scolded by hostess here
parts.note: a place where guests arrive after dark and a hostess welcomes them rather than telling them off

explanation.definitionFit: A late-night venue for dancing and drinks, often with hostesses.

clue.text: It smooths things over as a flirt moves on

indicators.note: moves signals that the letters of a flirt are shifted about

explanation.surface: A flirt glides on through life, smoothing things over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' rearranges A FLIRT into FLATIR; 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned iron heated on a stove for pressing clothes.

clue.text: Don't recognise plant in row

indicators.note: in shows that one word sits inside the other

parts.note: a din is a row, a loud noise
to sow is to plant seeds

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to acknowledge a plant set in a row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' looks like a line of plants; it is a noisy row.
explanation.definitionFit: To disown is to refuse to acknowledge as one's own.

clue.text: Rubbish left after excursion

indicators.note: after shows the letter for left follows the outing word

parts.note: a drive is an outing by car

explanation.surface: Litter is left behind after a day trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Drivel is nonsense, empty talk.

clue.text: Reacting badly to wild garlic the French put in

indicators.note: put in shows the French article goes inside the jumbled letters
wild suggests the letters of garlic run riot into a new order

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone's body reacts badly to the wild garlic the French cook with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' is the anagram signal and 'put in' the insertion; 'the French' is the French article.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hypersensitive to a substance, so that contact causes a bad reaction.

clue.text: Select new key for instrument

indicators.note: new signals that select is remade in a fresh order

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Pick a fresh key for a musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges SELECT into CELEST.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard instrument with hammers striking metal plates, giving a bell-like sound.

clue.text: Gives way to delays

explanation.definitionFit: To yield to another's wishes, and also to postpone.

clue.text: Tense claim to be practised?

definitions.meaning: a verb tense for incomplete past action
split as a boast that one is flawless

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the answer as two words, I'M PERFECT.
explanation.definitionFit: The grammatical tense for continuous past action, and also a boast of flawlessness.

clue.text: Group of animals noisily poked noses in thus

indicators.note: noisily signals that a word spoken sounds like the one entered

parts.note: a pride is a group of lions

explanation.surface: Lions noisily snooping on one another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thus' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Pried means meddled or snooped into others' affairs.

clue.text: Up to 50 attached to special unit

indicators.note: special asks for a specially altered version of unit

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty soldiers are attached to a special forces unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'special' rearranges UNIT into UNTI; 'attached to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Until means as far as a given time, before.

clue.text: Fellow in section is in poor shape

indicators.note: in shows the abbreviation goes inside the other word

parts.note: a unit is a section or part

explanation.surface: A colleague in a department is out of condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfit means not in good physical condition.

clue.text: Motorway speed on Eastern ruler's territory

indicators.note: on shows the motorway and speed come after the abbreviation for eastern

parts.note: the M1 is a British motorway, read as MI
rate means speed

explanation.surface: Driving at speed on a motorway into Arab lands.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway; its 1 is read as I.
explanation.definitionFit: A state governed by an emir, a Muslim ruler.

clue.text: Refined thief providing service with retiring personality

parts.note: the RAF is one of the armed services

indicators.note: retiring means the word for personality is drawn back, read in reverse

parts.note: one's self is one's personality

explanation.surface: A shy man in the armed forces turns out to be a gentleman thief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' looks like shy; it turns SELF into FLES. 'providing' and 'with' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A. J. Raffles is E. W. Hornung's gentleman burglar, a cricketer and cracksman.

clue.text: Sauce with food a woman's made up before

parts.note: a dressing is a sauce, as for salad
table means fare or food, as in keeping a good table

explanation.surface: A woman puts on salad dressing and food before making herself up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link. The furniture is where a woman sits to apply make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedroom table with a mirror where make-up is applied.
